lines.text: Many learners say: I am agree with you.
Agree is a verb. No am.

data.why: Agree is a verb. No am.

native.tip: Dalam bahasa Indonesia “saya setuju” tidak pakai “adalah”. Di bahasa Inggris juga: agree sudah kata kerja, jadi tidak perlu am.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “I am agree with you.” 😅 Agree sudah kata kerja, jadi tanpa am: “I agree with you.” Dengarkan Kak Ama, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “agree”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “I agree with you.” lalu tulis satu hal yang kamu setujui. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: In Indonesian “saya setuju” has no “adalah”. English is the same: agree is already a verb, so skip am.
en.caption: Ever say this? “I am agree with you.” 😅 Agree is already a verb, so no am: “I agree with you.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
